# The Craic Gazette (craicgpt.ie)

> Ireland's Most Artificially Intelligent Newspaper: a daily fun-news + AI-landscape paper
> written by open-source LLMs and published once a day after a rubric judge approves it. The
> pages are client-rendered views of public JSON editions — fetch the JSON, not the HTML.

## Today's edition

- [Latest pointer](https://craicgpt.ie/content/latest.json): `date`, `generated_at`,
  `language`, `headliner`, `edition` (path of today's `paper_content.json`), `versions`
  (path of the day's version manifest). Start here — editions are date-keyed and there is no
  paper on some days, so never guess dates.
- The edition it points at: `/content/YYYY/MM/DD/paper_content.json` (schema v3): `ai`
  (`headliner`, `subarticles[]`, `shorts[]`), `fun[]`, `editors_brief`, `about`, `podcast`,
  `podcast_tldr`, `layout[]`, `generated_at`.
- Prior versions of a day: `/content/YYYY/MM/DD/versions.json` → `versions[]` of `id`,
  `generated_at`, `seq`, `label`, `headliner`; each at `/content/YYYY/MM/DD/versions/<id>.json`.

## Languages

English lives at the root (`/content/...`; `/en/` is an alias). Translations live under a
language prefix with the same layout and their own pointer:
`/de/content/latest.json`, `/es/content/latest.json`, `/fr/content/latest.json`,
`/it/content/latest.json`, `/ja/content/latest.json`.

## Notes for agents

- Everything under `/content/*` and `/<lang>/content/*` is public, no auth. A 403 on a dated
  path means no edition that day (the Gazette takes days off), not an outage — follow the
  pointer instead.
- Every page carries `<link rel="alternate" type="application/json">` to its pointer.
- Sister site: the Geek with the Peak daily cybersecurity brief and AI desk —
  https://thegeekwiththepeak.com/llms.txt.
